pie.comment: Read pie as the lowercase header, testing its keyword boundary after any following directives. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and pie.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read the bounded showData flag. Follows pie.md#keyword-boundaries.
patterns.name: keyword.control.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows pie.md#composite-common-forms.
Read matching quoted strings and backslash escapes. Follows pie.md#strings.
Read a numeric section value and check the dot boundary through following directives. Follows pie.md#numbers and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the separator between a section label and its value. Follows pie.md#grammar.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.colon.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows pie.md#hidden-yaml.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows pie.md#hidden-directive.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows pie.md#comments.

pie-line-final-keywords.comment: Read the reserved accessibility description keyword when only padding and directives remain on its physical line, including after another complete unit. A later-line value receives its surrounding context's scopes. Follows pie.md#composite-common-forms and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
